data.narrative:
Vital Lyfe is a Seed-stage Climate & Energy company founded by Jonathan Criss and Andrew Harner that has raised $24M to date. The Climate & Energy sector comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers with comparable valuation metrics exist to support peer-median triangulation—the sector peer set lacks the three or more narrow-filter datapoints required for reliable multiples-based valuation.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable approach here. Using the $24M total raised as a proxy for post-money value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $60M. This method captures the expected value step when the company progresses beyond Seed toward Series A financing.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $51M (low) to $69M (high), with a median of $60M. The median reflects the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the absence of comparable Seed-stage peers in the Climate & Energy space, which limits cross-check validation. Any refinement would require either identification of additional early-stage sector peers or updated financial performance metrics that might support alternative methods. The range should be treated as preliminary pending deeper due diligence into the company's go-to-market trajectory and capital efficiency metrics relative to later-stage Climate & Energy benchmarks.
